project.name: Student Management Microservices (Asynchronous, Layered Architecture, Kafka)
project.description: Four independent Spring Boot microservices (student, course, enrollment, notification), each owning its own MySQL database. Controller-Service-DAO layered architecture (no Spring Data repositories, no JPA/Hibernate — plain JdbcTemplate DAOs). All cross-service communication is asynchronous, carried over Kafka topics instead of WebClient/RestClient/OpenFeign calls.
